author: Solomon II
text_post: I think you may have read something wrong. He did say that adding a feminine scent in along with your own cologne suggests you have women in your life, and demonstrates preselection, but he never said that wearing cologne was a bad thing. Unless of course you completely shower yourself in the stuff, that is. Making an effort to smell good doesn't telegraph interest, it demonstrates that you take care of yourself. It's just one of the many puzzle pieces that add up to the overall you. Just pick something you like and squirt a little on before you go out anywhere... personally I have a bit of a collection going, I think there are about 15 different fragrances sitting on my bedside table. Girls always notice them and I like to get them to pick their favourite... that way I know what to wear next time I see her, and they always react well to it. Very good for push/pull.
